cases.prompt: Review a read-only Git/path validator that already handles normal repository-relative paths. Harden it against malformed refs and hostile path text without changing its owner or adding a writer.
cases.expected_output: A bounded hardening review that exercises malformed and ambiguous path/ref classes, preserves owner-defined FAIL versus UNKNOWN semantics, and performs no mutation.
assertions: Checks empty/whitespace, NUL/control characters, Unicode surrogate or normalization-sensitive input.
Checks absolute, traversal, non-canonical, separator/platform variants and option-like refs.
Distinguishes character limits from encoded-byte or path-component ceilings when owner-defined.
Keeps missing or ambiguous evidence UNKNOWN rather than manufacturing PASS or FAIL.
Does not auto-rewrite paths, invent repository state, or replace Required.

cases.prompt: Review a classifier that consumes a bounded JSON fixture and distinguishes live from frozen registry evidence. Find parser and schema edge classes without changing registry authority.
cases.expected_output: A bounded structured-data hardening review covering parser ambiguity, duplicate keys, malformed shapes, size/depth limits, additional fields, and uncertainty without rewriting registry truth.
assertions: Checks duplicate JSON keys when parser behavior matters.
Checks wrong scalar/container types, malformed shapes, oversize documents/fields and deep nesting.
Checks unknown/additional fields according to the owning schema and decode/parser failures.
Keeps parser ambiguity and insufficient evidence explicit rather than normalizing them into PASS.
Does not rewrite registry data or create a second truth store.

cases.prompt: Review a read-only source classifier that currently matches literal parent-depth and helper-reference expressions. Harden its source/AST handling without changing the classifier owner or adding an automatic rewriter.
cases.expected_output: A source/AST hardening review that treats computed expressions, aliasing, indirection, generated forms, unsupported syntax and parse failures as explicit evidence classes rather than assuming unmatched source is safe.
assertions: Exercises computed or dynamic expressions that defeat literal matching.
Checks aliasing, indirection, imports or generated forms when relevant to the owner contract.
Treats unsupported syntax and parse failures as explicit uncertainty or owner-defined failure, never as safe-by-no-match.
Separates semantically similar forms whose source text differs.
Does not introduce an automatic source rewriter.

cases.prompt: Review a Git-backed read-only classifier that resolves candidate objects and path identity. Stress object-type and availability ambiguity while preserving fail-closed semantics.
cases.expected_output: A Git/object hardening review that verifies exact object types and availability, distinguishes blob/tree/symlink/gitlink cases, checks ambient Git poisoning and preserves UNKNOWN for missing evidence without mutating Git.
assertions: Checks missing or unavailable objects and malformed or unsupported object IDs.
Distinguishes blob, tree, symlink and gitlink instead of trusting SHA-shaped text.
Checks partial clone/lazy availability and replacement objects where applicable.
Checks ambient Git repository, config, pathspec, trace or environment poisoning where relevant.
Does not fetch or mutate missing evidence unless the owning contract separately authorizes that effect.

cases.prompt: A small pure validator checks one closed enum with exhaustive owner tests and no filesystem, JSON, AST, Git, subprocess, or external evidence. Review only whether its current contract is adequately covered.
cases.expected_output: A compact review that marks unrelated dimensions NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_OWNER_BASIS from current owner evidence, preserves the exhaustive enum tests, and avoids broad repository archaeology or new dependencies.
assertions: Does not force Git-object, filesystem, JSON or network checks when owner evidence proves them not applicable.
Does not force Hypothesis or another testing framework.
Preserves the existing narrow validator boundary.
Does not broaden the validator merely because the skill lists seven dimensions.

cases.prompt: Harden this classifier, but no current source path, project owner, guideline, or result vocabulary can be established.
cases.expected_output: Stop with review disposition UNKNOWN and reason code REVIEW_BLOCKED_UNKNOWN_OWNER; do not guess an owner, invent result semantics, or write a replacement validator.
assertions: Uses UNKNOWN as the declared review disposition.
Includes reason code REVIEW_BLOCKED_UNKNOWN_OWNER.
Does not invent PASS/FAIL semantics.
Does not write or recommend a replacement validator as a way around missing ownership.
